facts.business: Rajputana Stainless Limited manufactures stainless steel products including billets, ingots, bright bars, and other steel products.
key_risks: Inventory valuation involves significant management judgment in determining stage-wise cost of work-in-progress, allocation of conversion costs, and estimation of net realizable value
Manufacturing process involves multiple stages with inherent process losses and yield variations impacting inventory valuation
facts.related_party_note: The Company has formulated a Policy on Related Party Transactions accessible at https://www.rajputanastainless.com/investor-relations/cA==/Policies-&-Programmes
